```kotlin
class BankingService {
    private val users = mutableMapOf<String, User>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val sampleUser = User(
            id = "1",
            name = "John Doe",
            email = "john@example.com",
            accounts = listOf(
                Account("12345678", "Checking", 1500.00, "USD"),
                Account("87654321", "Savings", 5000.00, "USD")
            ),
            transactions = listOf(
                Transaction("1", "2023-05-01", "Grocery Store", -50.00, TransactionType.PAYMENT, 1450.00),
                Transaction("2", "2023-05-02", "Salary", 2000.00, TransactionType.DEPOSIT, 3450.00),
                Transaction("3", "2023-05-03", "Electric Bill", -100.00, TransactionType.PAYMENT, 3350.00)
            )
        )
        users[sampleUser.id] = sampleUser
    }

    fun login(email: String, password: String): User? {
        // In a real app, you would authenticate with a backend service
        return users.values.find { it.email == email }
    }

    fun getUserAccounts(userId: String): List<Account> {
        return users[userId]?.accounts ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun getUserTransactions(userId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return users[userId]?.transactions ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun transferMoney(fromAccount: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        // In a real app, this would be a network call
        return true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private val bankingService = BankingService()

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        binding.loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val email = binding.emailEditText.text.toString()
            val password = binding.passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (email.isNotEmpty() && password.isNotEmpty()) {
                val user = bankingService.login(email, password)
                if (user != null) {
                    val intent = Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java)
                    intent.putExtra("USER_ID", user.id)
                    startActivity(intent)
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### activities/MainActivity.kt
```kotlin
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityMainBinding
    private val bankingService = BankingService()
    private lateinit var userId: String

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID") ?: ""

        setupAccounts()
        setupTransactions()

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val intent = Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java)
            intent.putExtra("USER_ID", userId)
            startActivity(intent)
        }
    }

    private fun setupAccounts() {
        val accounts = bankingService.getUserAccounts(userId)
        binding.accountsContainer.removeAllViews()

        accounts.forEach { account ->
            val accountView = layoutInflater.inflate(R.layout.view_account, binding.accountsContainer, false)
            accountView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.accountNumberTextView).text = "Account: ${account.accountNumber}"
            accountView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.accountTypeTextView).text = account.accountType
            accountView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.balanceTextView).text = "${account.balance} ${account.currency}"

            binding.accountsContainer.addView(accountView)
        }
    }

    private fun setupTransactions() {
        val transactions = bankingService.getUserTransactions(userId)
        val adapter = TransactionAdapter(transactions)
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.adapter = adapter
    }
}
```

### adapters/TransactionAdapter.kt
```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val dateTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.dateTextView)
        val descriptionTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.descriptionTextView)
        val amountTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.amountTextView)
        val balanceTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.balanceTextView)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_transaction, parent, false)
        return TransactionViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.dateTextView.text = transaction.date
        holder.descriptionTextView.text = transaction.description
        holder.amountTextView.text = "${transaction.amount}"

        // Set color based on transaction type
        when (transaction.type) {
            TransactionType.DEPOSIT -> holder.amountTextView.setTextColor(Color.GREEN)
            TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL, TransactionType.PAYMENT -> holder.amountTextView.setTextColor(Color.RED)
            TransactionType.TRANSFER -> holder.amountTextView.setTextColor(Color.BLUE)
        }

        holder.balanceTextView.text = "Balance: ${transaction.balanceAfter}"
    }

    override fun getItemCount() = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransferBinding
    private val bankingService = BankingService()
    private lateinit var userId: String

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransferBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID") ?: ""

        setupAccountSpinners()

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccount = binding.fromAccountSpinner.selectedItem.toString()
            val toAccount = binding.toAccountEditText.text.toString()
            val amount = binding.amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()

            if (fromAccount.isNotEmpty() && toAccount.isNotEmpty() && amount != null && amount > 0) {
                val success = bankingService.transferMoney(fromAccount, toAccount, amount)
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all fields correctly", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun setupAccountSpinners() {
        val accounts = bankingService.getUserAccounts(userId)
        val accountNumbers = accounts.map { it.accountNumber }

        val adapter = ArrayAdapter(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, accountNumbers)
        adapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item)
        binding.fromAccountSpinner.adapter = adapter
    }
}
```

# Native Android Banking Application

Below is a basic implementation of a native Android banking application. This example includes key features like login, account overview, transaction history, and money transfer.

## 1. Project Setup

First, create a new Android project in Android Studio with an Empty Activity.

### a. Login Activity (`LoginActivity.kt`)

```kotlin
import android.content.Intent
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast

class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var usernameEditText: EditText
    private lateinit var passwordEditText: EditText
    private lateinit var loginButton: Button

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_login)

        usernameEditText = findViewById(R.id.usernameEditText)
        passwordEditText = findViewById(R.id.passwordEditText)
        loginButton = findViewById(R.id.loginButton)

        loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val username = usernameEditText.text.toString()
            val password = passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (validateCredentials(username, password)) {
                // Navigate to main activity
                val intent = Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateCredentials(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, you would validate against a backend service
        return username == "user" && password == "password"
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup

import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView

class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val descriptionTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.descriptionTextView)
        val dateTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.dateTextView)
        val amountTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.amountTextView)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_transaction, parent, false)
        return TransactionViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.descriptionTextView.text = transaction.description
        holder.dateTextView.text = transaction.date
        holder.amountTextView.text = "$${"%.2f".format(transaction.amount)}"
    }

    override fun getItemCount() = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var etPassword: EditText
    private lateinit var btnLogin: Button

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        // Check if user is already logged in
        val preferenceManager = PreferenceManager(this)
        if (preferenceManager.isLoggedIn()) {
            startActivity(Intent(this, HomeActivity::class.java))
            finish()
            return
        }

        etUsername = findViewById(R.id.etUsername)
        etPassword = findViewById(R.id.etPassword)
        btnLogin = findViewById(R.id.btnLogin)

        btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val username = etUsername.text.toString().trim()
            val password = etPassword.text.toString().trim()

            if (validateInput(username, password)) {
                // In a real app, you would authenticate with a backend service
                // For demo purposes, we'll just check for non-empty fields
                preferenceManager.saveLoginStatus(true)
                startActivity(Intent(this, HomeActivity::class.java))
                finish()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateInput(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        if (username.isEmpty()) {
            etUsername.error = "Username is required"
            return false
        }

        if (password.isEmpty()) {
            etPassword.error = "Password is required"
            return false
        }

        return true
    }
```

```kotlin
        btnTransfer.setOnClickListener {
```

```kotlin
            val amount = etAmount.text.toString().trim()

            if (validateInput(recipient, amount)) {
                // In a real app, you would process the transfer with a backend service
                Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer of $$amount to $recipient completed", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                finish()
            }
        }

    private fun validateInput(recipient: String, amount: String): Boolean {
        if (recipient.isEmpty()) {
            etRecipient.error = "Recipient is required"
            return false
        }

        if (amount.isEmpty()) {
            etAmount.error = "Amount is required"
            return false
        }

            if (amountValue <= 0) {
                etAmount.error = "Amount must be positive"
                return false
            }

            return false
        }

    }
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.utils

import android.content.Context

class PreferenceManager(context: Context) {
    private val sharedPreferences: SharedPreferences =
        context.getSharedPreferences("BankingAppPrefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    companion object {
        private const val KEY_IS_LOGGED_IN = "is_logged_in"
    }

    fun saveLoginStatus(isLoggedIn: Boolean) {
        sharedPreferences.edit().putBoolean(KEY_IS_LOGGED_IN, isLoggedIn).apply()

    fun isLoggedIn(): Boolean {
        return sharedPreferences.getBoolean(KEY_IS_LOGGED_IN, false)
    }
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.adapters

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.bankingapp.R
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction

class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val tvDescription: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvDescription)
        val tvDate: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvDate)
        val tvAmount: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAmount)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_transaction, parent, false)
        return TransactionViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.tvDescription.text = transaction.description
        holder.tvDate.text = transaction.date
        holder.tvAmount.text = "$${"%.2f".format(transaction.amount)}"

        // Change color based on transaction type
        if (transaction.amount < 0) {
            holder.tvAmount.setTextColor(holder.itemView.context.getColor(R.color.red))
        } else {
            holder.tvAmount.setTextColor(holder.itemView.context.getColor(R.color.green))
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
class BankService {
    private val users = mutableListOf<User>()
    private val transactions = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<Transaction>>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val account1 = Account("123456789", 1500.0, "USD", "Checking")
        val account2 = Account("987654321", 5000.0, "USD", "Savings")
        val user = User("1", "John Doe", "john@example.com", listOf(account1, account2))
        users.add(user)

        transactions[account1.accountNumber] = mutableListOf(
            Transaction("1", "2023-01-15", 100.0, "Grocery Store", "DEBIT", 1400.0),
            Transaction("2", "2023-01-20", 200.0, "Salary", "CREDIT", 1600.0)
        )
    }

    fun authenticate(email: String, password: String): User? {
        // In a real app, this would call an API
        return users.find { it.email == email }
    }

    fun getAccountBalance(accountNumber: String): Double? {
        return users.flatMap { it.accounts }.find { it.accountNumber == accountNumber }?.balance
    }

    fun getTransactions(accountNumber: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions[accountNumber] ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun transferMoney(fromAccount: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val from = users.flatMap { it.accounts }.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }
        val to = users.flatMap { it.accounts }.find { it.accountNumber == toAccount }

        if (from != null && to != null && from.balance >= amount) {
            // Update balances
            from.balance -= amount
            to.balance += amount

            // Add transactions
            val fromTransaction = Transaction(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
                amount,
                "Transfer to $toAccount",
                "DEBIT",
                from.balance
            )

            val toTransaction = Transaction(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
                amount,
                "Transfer from $fromAccount",
                "CREDIT",
                to.balance
            )

            transactions[fromAccount]?.add(fromTransaction)
            transactions[toAccount]?.add(toTransaction)

            return true
        }
        return false
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransferBinding
    private val bankService = BankService()
    private lateinit var user: User

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransferBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        val userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID")
        user = bankService.users.find { it.id == userId } ?: return

        setupUI()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        // Populate from account spinner
        val fromAccounts = user.accounts.map { it.accountNumber }
        val fromAdapter = ArrayAdapter(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, fromAccounts)
        binding.fromAccountSpinner.adapter = fromAdapter

        // Populate to account spinner (could be other accounts or external)
        val toAccounts = listOf("987654321", "111111111") // Sample external accounts
        val toAdapter = ArrayAdapter(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, toAccounts)
        binding.toAccountSpinner.adapter = toAdapter

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccount = binding.fromAccountSpinner.selectedItem.toString()
            val toAccount = binding.toAccountSpinner.selectedItem.toString()
            val amount = binding.amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()

            if (amount != null && amount > 0) {
                val success = bankService.transferMoney(fromAccount, toAccount, amount)
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter a valid amount", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.example.bankingapp.databinding.ActivityMainBinding

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityMainBinding

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        // Check if user is logged in
        val sharedPref = getSharedPreferences("BankingAppPrefs", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val isLoggedIn = sharedPref.getBoolean("isLoggedIn", false)

        if (!isLoggedIn) {
            startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))
            finish()
            return
        }

        setupUI()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        binding.btnViewAccounts.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, AccountsActivity::class.java))
        }

        binding.btnViewTransactions.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, TransactionsActivity::class.java))
        }

        binding.btnTransferMoney.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java))
        }

        binding.btnLogout.setOnClickListener {
            val sharedPref = getSharedPreferences("BankingAppPrefs", MODE_PRIVATE)
            with(sharedPref.edit()) {
                putBoolean("isLoggedIn", false)
                apply()
            }
            startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))
            finish()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.services

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import com.example.bankingapp.models.User

class AuthService(context: Context) {
    private val prefs: SharedPreferences = context.getSharedPreferences("BankingPrefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun login(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, this would call an API
        if (username == "user" && password == "password") {
            val user = User(username, "John Doe", "1234567890", "john@example.com")
            saveUser(user)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    fun logout() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    }

    fun isLoggedIn(): Boolean {
        return prefs.contains("username")
    }

    fun getCurrentUser(): User? {
        if (!isLoggedIn()) return null
        return User(
            prefs.getString("username", "")!!,
            prefs.getString("name", "")!!,
            prefs.getString("accountNumber", "")!!,
            prefs.getString("email", "")!!
        )
    }

    private fun saveUser(user: User) {
        prefs.edit()
            .putString("username", user.username)
            .putString("name", user.name)
            .putString("accountNumber", user.accountNumber)
            .putString("email", user.email)
            .apply()
    }
}
```

### BankingService.kt
```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.services

import android.content.Context
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction

class BankingService(context: Context) {
    private val accounts = mutableListOf<Account>()
    private val transactions = mutableListOf<Transaction>()

    init {
        // Initialize with sample data
        accounts.add(Account("1234567890", "Savings", 5000.00))
        accounts.add(Account("0987654321", "Checking", 2500.00))

        transactions.add(Transaction("1", "1234567890", "2023-05-01", "Deposit", 1000.00, "Salary"))
        transactions.add(Transaction("2", "1234567890", "2023-05-02", "Withdrawal", -200.00, "Grocery"))
    }

    fun getAccounts(): List<Account> {
        return accounts
    }

    fun getTransactions(accountNumber: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions.filter { it.accountNumber == accountNumber }
    }

    fun transfer(fromAccount: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val from = accounts.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }
        val to = accounts.find { it.accountNumber == toAccount }

        if (from == null || to == null || from.balance < amount) {
            return false
        }

        from.balance -= amount
        to.balance += amount

        // Add transaction records
        val transactionId = (transactions.size + 1).toString()
        transactions.add(Transaction(transactionId, fromAccount, "2023-05-03", "Transfer", -amount, "Transfer to $toAccount"))
        transactions.add(Transaction(transactionId, toAccount, "2023-05-03", "Transfer", amount, "Transfer from $fromAccount"))

        return true
    }
}
```

### ApiService.kt
```kotlin
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.gson.GsonConverterFactory
import retrofit2.http.*

interface ApiService {
    @POST("auth/login")
    suspend fun login(@Body credentials: Map<String, String>): User

    @GET("accounts/{accountNumber}/balance")
    suspend fun getBalance(@Path("accountNumber") accountNumber: String): Account

    @GET("accounts/{accountNumber}/transactions")
    suspend fun getTransactions(
        @Path("accountNumber") accountNumber: String,
        @Query("limit") limit: Int = 20
    ): List<Transaction>

    @POST("transactions/transfer")
    suspend fun transferFunds(@Body transferRequest: TransferRequest): Transaction

    companion object {
        private const val BASE_URL = "https://api.yourbank.com/v1/"

        fun create(): ApiService {
            val retrofit = Retrofit.Builder()
                .baseUrl(BASE_URL)
                .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
                .build()

            return retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
        }
    }
}

data class TransferRequest(
    val fromAccount: String,
    val toAccount: String,
    val amount: Double,
    val description: String
)
```

## 5. ViewModel

### BankingViewModel.kt
```kotlin
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class BankingViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val _user = MutableStateFlow<User?>(null)
    val user: StateFlow<User?> = _user

    private val _balance = MutableStateFlow<Account?>(null)
    val balance: StateFlow<Account?> = _balance

    private val _transactions = MutableStateFlow<List<Transaction>>(emptyList())
    val transactions: StateFlow<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    private val _isLoading = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isLoading: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isLoading

    private val _error = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val error: StateFlow<String?> = _error

    private val apiService = ApiService.create()

    fun login(email: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isLoading.value = true
            _error.value = null

            try {
                val response = apiService.login(mapOf("email" to email, "password" to password))
                _user.value = response
                if (response.accounts.isNotEmpty()) {
                    fetchBalance(response.accounts[0].accountNumber)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _error.value = "Login failed: ${e.message}"
            } finally {
                _isLoading.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    fun fetchBalance(accountNumber: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isLoading.value = true
            _error.value = null

            try {
                val response = apiService.getBalance(accountNumber)
                _balance.value = response
                fetchTransactions(accountNumber)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _error.value = "Failed to fetch balance: ${e.message}"
            } finally {
                _isLoading.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    fun fetchTransactions(accountNumber: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isLoading.value = true
            _error.value = null

            try {
                val response = apiService.getTransactions(accountNumber)
                _transactions.value = response
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _error.value = "Failed to fetch transactions: ${e.message}"
            } finally {
                _isLoading.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccount: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double, description: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isLoading.value = true
            _error.value = null

            try {
                val request = TransferRequest(fromAccount, toAccount, amount, description)
                val response = apiService.transferFunds(request)
                fetchBalance(fromAccount)
                _error.value = "Transfer successful"
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _error.value = "Transfer failed: ${e.message}"
            } finally {
                _isLoading.value = false
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### TransactionAdapter.kt
```kotlin
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.bankingapp.databinding.ItemTransactionBinding

class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        holder.bind(transactions[position])
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = transactions.size

    inner class TransactionViewHolder(private val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {

        fun bind(transaction: Transaction) {
            binding.tvDate.text = transaction.date
            binding.tvDescription.text = transaction.description
            binding.tvAmount.text = "${transaction.amount}"

            when (transaction.type) {
                "credit" -> {
                    binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(binding.root.resources.getColor(android.R.color.holo_green_dark))
                }
                "debit" -> {
                    binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(binding.root.resources.getColor(android.R.color.holo_red_dark))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

fun getEncryptedSharedPreferences(context: Context): SharedPreferences {
    val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    return EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_prefs",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )
}
```

### BankService.kt
```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.services

import com.example.bankingapp.models.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.models.User
import java.util.*

object BankService {
    private val users = mutableListOf<User>()
    private val accounts = mutableMapOf<String, Account>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        users.add(User("user1", "password1"))
        users.add(User("user2", "password2"))

        val account1 = Account(
            accountNumber = "123456789",
            accountName = "John Doe",
            balance = 1500.00,
            transactions = mutableListOf(
                Transaction("Deposit", 500.00, Date()),
                Transaction("Withdrawal", -200.00, Date()),
                Transaction("Transfer", -100.00, Date())
            )
        )

        val account2 = Account(
            accountNumber = "987654321",
            accountName = "Jane Smith",
            balance = 3000.00,
            transactions = mutableListOf(
                Transaction("Deposit", 1000.00, Date()),
                Transaction("Transfer", 500.00, Date())
            )
        )

        accounts["user1"] = account1
        accounts["user2"] = account2
    }

    fun authenticate(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        return users.any { it.username == username && it.password == password }
    }

    fun getAccount(username: String): Account {
        return accounts[username] ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Account not found")
    }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccountNumber: String, toAccountNumber: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromAccount = accounts.values.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccountNumber }
        val toAccount = accounts.values.find { it.accountNumber == toAccountNumber }

        if (fromAccount != null && toAccount != null && fromAccount.balance >= amount) {
            fromAccount.balance -= amount
            toAccount.balance += amount

            // Add transactions
            fromAccount.transactions.add(Transaction("Transfer to $toAccountNumber", -amount, Date()))
            toAccount.transactions.add(Transaction("Transfer from $fromAccountNumber", amount, Date()))

            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    fun addTransaction(accountNumber: String, description: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val account = accounts.values.find { it.accountNumber == accountNumber }
        if (account != null) {
            account.balance += amount
            account.transactions.add(Transaction(description, amount, Date()))
            return true
        }
        return false
    }
}
```

### adapters/TransactionAdapter.kt
```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false)
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.binding.dateTextView.text = transaction.date
        holder.binding.descriptionTextView.text = transaction.description
        holder.binding.amountTextView.text = "$${transaction.amount}"
        holder.binding.balanceTextView.text = "$${transaction.balanceAfter}"

        when (transaction.type) {
            "DEBIT" -> {
                holder.binding.amountTextView.setTextColor(Color.RED)
                holder.binding.amountTextView.text = "-$${transaction.amount}"
            }
            "CREDIT" -> {
                holder.binding.amountTextView.setTextColor(Color.GREEN)
                holder.binding.amountTextView.text = "+$${transaction.amount}"
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount() = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
// DashboardViewModel.kt
class DashboardViewModel(private val repository: BankingRepository) : ViewModel() {
    private val _user = MutableLiveData<User>()
    val user: LiveData<User> = _user

    private val _accounts = MutableLiveData<List<Account>>()
    val accounts: LiveData<List<Account>> = _accounts

    private val _transactions = MutableLiveData<List<Transaction>>()
    val transactions: LiveData<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    private val _error = MutableLiveData<String>()
    val error: LiveData<String> = _error

    fun loadUserData(userId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.getAccounts(userId).onSuccess { accounts ->
                _accounts.value = accounts
                if (accounts.isNotEmpty()) {
                    loadTransactions(accounts[0].id)
                }
            }.onFailure { error ->
                _error.value = error.message
            }
        }
    }

    fun loadTransactions(accountId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.getTransactions(accountId).onSuccess { transactions ->
                _transactions.value = transactions
            }.onFailure { error ->
                _error.value = error.message
            }
        }
    }

    fun transferFunds(
        fromAccountId: String,
        toAccountNumber: String,
        amount: Double,
        description: String
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.transferFunds(fromAccountId, toAccountNumber, amount, description)
                .onSuccess { transaction ->
                    // Refresh data after successful transfer
                    loadUserData(_user.value?.id ?: return@launch)
                }.onFailure { error ->
                    _error.value = error.message
                }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// DashboardActivity.kt
class DashboardActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityDashboardBinding
    private val viewModel: DashboardViewModel by viewModels()
    private lateinit var accountAdapter: AccountAdapter
    private lateinit var transactionAdapter: TransactionAdapter

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityDashboardBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        val userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID") ?: return finish()

        setupAdapters()
        setupObservers()
        viewModel.loadUserData(userId)

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val intent = Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java)
            intent.putExtra("ACCOUNTS", ArrayList(viewModel.accounts.value ?: emptyList()))
            startActivity(intent)
        }
    }

    private fun setupAdapters() {
        accountAdapter = AccountAdapter { account ->
            viewModel.loadTransactions(account.id)
        }
        binding.accountsRecyclerView.adapter = accountAdapter

        transactionAdapter = TransactionAdapter()
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.adapter = transactionAdapter
    }

    private fun setupObservers() {
        viewModel.accounts.observe(this) { accounts ->
            accountAdapter.submitList(accounts)
            if (accounts.isNotEmpty()) {
                binding.balanceTextView.text = getString(
                    R.string.balance_format,
                    accounts[0].balance,
                    accounts[0].currency
                )
            }
        }

        viewModel.transactions.observe(this) { transactions ->
            transactionAdapter.submitList(transactions)
        }

        viewModel.error.observe(this) { error ->
            Toast.makeText(this, error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// TransferActivity.kt
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransferBinding
    private val viewModel: DashboardViewModel by viewModels()

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransferBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        val accounts = intent.getSerializableExtra("ACCOUNTS") as? List<Account> ?: emptyList()

        // Setup spinner for account selection
        val adapter = ArrayAdapter(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item,
            accounts.map { "${it.accountType} - ${it.accountNumber}" }
        )
        adapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item)
        binding.fromAccountSpinner.adapter = adapter

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccount = accounts[binding.fromAccountSpinner.selectedItemPosition]
            val toAccountNumber = binding.toAccountEditText.text.toString()
            val amount = binding.amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()
            val description = binding.descriptionEditText.text.toString()

            if (toAccountNumber.isNotEmpty() && amount != null && amount > 0) {
                viewModel.transferFunds(
                    fromAccount.id,
                    toAccountNumber,
                    amount,
                    description
                )
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter valid details", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        viewModel.error.observe(this) { error ->
            Toast.makeText(this, error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
```

```kotlin
// LoginActivity.kt
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()

        binding.loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val email = binding.emailEditText.text.toString()
            val password = binding.passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (email.isNotEmpty() && password.isNotEmpty()) {
                loginUser(email, password)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        binding.registerTextView.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, RegisterActivity::class.java))
        }
    }

    private fun loginUser(email: String, password: String) {
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
            .addOnCompleteListener(this) { task ->
                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                if (task.isSuccessful) {
                    startActivity(Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java))
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(
                        this,
                        "Authentication failed: ${task.exception?.message}",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                }
            }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityRegisterBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()

        binding.registerButton.setOnClickListener {
            val email = binding.emailEditText.text.toString()
            val password = binding.passwordEditText.text.toString()
            val confirmPassword = binding.confirmPasswordEditText.text.toString()

            if (email.isNotEmpty() && password.isNotEmpty() && confirmPassword.isNotEmpty()) {
                if (password == confirmPassword) {
                    registerUser(email, password)
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Passwords don't match", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        binding.loginTextView.setOnClickListener {
            finish()
        }
    }

    private fun registerUser(email: String, password: String) {
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
            .addOnCompleteListener(this) { task ->
                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                if (task.isSuccessful) {
```

```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.binding.apply {
            descriptionTextView.text = transaction.description
            amountTextView.text = "$${"%.2f".format(transaction.amount)}"
            dateTextView.text = transaction.date

            // Set color based on transaction type
            amountTextView.setTextColor(
                if (transaction.amount > 0) {
                    ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, R.color.green)
                } else {
                    ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, R.color.red)
```

```kotlin
import android.content.Intent
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast
import com.example.bankingapp.R

class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_login)

        val usernameEditText = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.usernameEditText)
        val passwordEditText = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.passwordEditText)
        val loginButton = findViewById<Button>(R.id.loginButton)

        loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val username = usernameEditText.text.toString()
            val password = passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (validateCredentials(username, password)) {
                // Navigate to Dashboard
                val intent = Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java)
                intent.putExtra("USERNAME", username)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateCredentials(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, this would call an authentication API
        return username.isNotEmpty() && password.isNotEmpty()
    }
}
```

### Transaction Adapter (TransactionAdapter.kt)

```kotlin
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.bankingapp.R
import com.example.bankingapp.model.Transaction

class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val descriptionTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.transactionDescription)
        val dateTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.transactionDate)
        val amountTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.transactionAmount)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_transaction, parent, false)
        return TransactionViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.descriptionTextView.text = transaction.description
        holder.dateTextView.text = transaction.date
        holder.amountTextView.text = "$${"%.2f".format(transaction.amount)}"

        // Change color based on transaction type
        if (transaction.amount < 0) {
            holder.amountTextView.setTextColor(holder.itemView.context.getColor(android.R.color.holo_red_dark))
        } else {
            holder.amountTextView.setTextColor(holder.itemView.context.getColor(android.R.color.holo_green_dark))
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount() = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
// LoginActivity.kt
package com.example.bankingapp.auth

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.example.bankingapp.MainActivity
import com.example.bankingapp.databinding.ActivityLoginBinding
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth

class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        auth = Firebase.auth

        binding.loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val email = binding.emailEditText.text.toString()
            val password = binding.passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (email.isNotEmpty() && password.isNotEmpty()) {
                loginUser(email, password)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        binding.registerTextView.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, RegisterActivity::class.java))
        }
    }

    private fun loginUser(email: String, password: String) {
        auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
            .addOnCompleteListener(this) { task ->
                if (task.isSuccessful) {
                    // Sign in success
                    startActivity(Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java))
                    finish()
                } else {
                    // If sign in fails
                    Toast.makeText(
                        baseContext, "Authentication failed.",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                }
            }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// AppDatabase.kt
@Database(entities = [User::class, Transaction::class], version = 1)
abstract class AppDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun userDao(): UserDao
    abstract fun transactionDao(): TransactionDao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: AppDatabase? = null

        fun getDatabase(context: Context): AppDatabase {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                val instance = Room.databaseBuilder(
                    context.applicationContext,
                    AppDatabase::class.java,
                    "banking_app_db"
                ).build()
                INSTANCE = instance
                instance
            }
        }
    }
}

// UserDao.kt
@Dao
interface UserDao {
    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insert(user: User)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM user WHERE email = :email AND password = :password")
    suspend fun login(email: String, password: String): User?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM user WHERE id = :userId")
    suspend fun getUser(userId: String): User?
}

// TransactionDao.kt
@Dao
interface TransactionDao {
    @Insert
    suspend fun insert(transaction: Transaction)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM transaction WHERE userId = :userId ORDER BY date DESC")
    suspend fun getTransactions(userId: String): List<Transaction>
}
```

```kotlin
class BankingViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {

    val user: LiveData<User?> = _user

    private val _transactions = MutableLiveData<List<Transaction>>()
    val transactions: LiveData<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    val loginResult: LiveData<Boolean> = _loginResult

    fun login(email: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val user = userDao.login(email, password)
            _user.value = user
            _loginResult.value = user != null
        }
    }

    fun loadTransactions(userId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _transactions.value = transactionDao.getTransactions(userId)
        }
    }

    fun addTransaction(transaction: Transaction) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            transactionDao.insert(transaction)
            loadTransactions(transaction.userId)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// BankingRepository.kt
class BankingRepository(private val userDao: UserDao, private val transactionDao: TransactionDao) {

    suspend fun getUser(userId: String): User? = userDao.getUser(userId)

    suspend fun updateUser(user: User) = userDao.update(user)

    suspend fun getTransactions(userId: String): List<Transaction> =
        transactionDao.getTransactions(userId)

    suspend fun addTransaction(transaction: Transaction) =
        transactionDao.insert(transaction)

    suspend fun makeTransfer(
        senderId: String,
        recipientId: String,
        amount: Double,
        description: String
    ) {
        // In a real app, this would be a transaction with proper error handling
        val sender = getUser(senderId) ?: throw Exception("Sender not found")
        val recipient = getUser(recipientId) ?: throw Exception("Recipient not found")

        if (sender.balance < amount) throw Exception("Insufficient funds")

        val newSenderBalance = sender.balance - amount
        val newRecipientBalance = recipient.balance + amount

        updateUser(sender.copy(balance = newSenderBalance))
        updateUser(recipient.copy(balance = newRecipientBalance))

        val transaction = Transaction(
            id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
            amount = amount,
            date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
            type = TransactionType.TRANSFER,
            description = description,
            recipient = recipient.name
        )

        addTransaction(transaction)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)

        // Observe user data

                binding.tvAccountNumber.text = "Account: ${it.accountNumber}"
                binding.tvBalance.text = String.format("$%.2f", it.balance)
            }
        }

        // Observe transactions
        viewModel.transactions.observe(this) { transactions ->
            val adapter = TransactionAdapter(transactions)
            binding.rvTransactions.adapter = adapter
        }

        // Observe errors
        viewModel.error.observe(this) { error ->
            error?.let {
                Toast.makeText(this, it, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                viewModel.clearError()
            }
        }

        // Set up navigation

            when (item.itemId) {

                R.id.nav_transfer -> {

                    true

                R.id.nav_profile -> {

            .replace(R.id.fragment_container, TransferFragment())
            .addToBackStack(null)

    }

    }
```

```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.binding.tvAmount.text = String.format("$%.2f", transaction.amount)
        holder.binding.tvDate.text = transaction.date
        holder.binding.tvDescription.text = transaction.description

        when (transaction.type) {
            TransactionType.DEPOSIT -> {
                holder.binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(Color.GREEN)
            }
            TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL, TransactionType.TRANSFER -> {
                holder.binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(Color.RED)
            }
            TransactionType.PAYMENT -> {
                holder.binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(Color.BLUE)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount() = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
class TransferFragment : Fragment() {
```

### BankingViewModel.kt
```kotlin
class BankingViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val repository: BankingRepository
    private val _user = MutableLiveData<User?>()
    val user: LiveData<User?> = _user

    private val _accounts = MutableLiveData<List<Account>>()
    val accounts: LiveData<List<Account>> = _accounts

    private val _transactions = MutableLiveData<List<Transaction>>()
    val transactions: LiveData<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    init {
        val appDatabase = AppDatabase.getDatabase(application)
        repository = BankingRepository(appDatabase)
    }

    fun loadUser(userId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _user.value = repository.getUser(userId)
        }
    }

    fun loadAccounts(userId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _accounts.value = repository.getAccounts(userId)
        }
    }

    fun loadTransactions(accountId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _transactions.value = repository.getTransactions(accountId)
        }
    }

    fun performTransaction(transaction: Transaction) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.saveTransaction(transaction)

            // Update account balance
            val account = repository.getAccount(transaction.accountId)
            account?.let {
                val newBalance = when (transaction.type) {
                    "Deposit" -> it.balance + transaction.amount
                    "Withdrawal" -> it.balance - transaction.amount
                    else -> it.balance
                }
                repository.saveAccount(it.copy(balance = newBalance))
                loadAccounts(it.userId)
            }

            loadTransactions(transaction.accountId)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class HomeFragment : Fragment() {
    private var _binding: FragmentHomeBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!
    private lateinit var viewModel: BankingViewModel

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentHomeBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        viewModel = ViewModelProvider(requireActivity()).get(BankingViewModel::class.java)

        setupObservers()
    }

    private fun setupObservers() {
        viewModel.user.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { user ->
            user?.let {
                binding.tvWelcome.text = "Welcome, ${it.firstName}!"
                Glide.with(this)
                    .load(it.profilePictureUrl)
                    .placeholder(R.drawable.ic_profile)
                    .into(binding.ivProfile)
            }
        }

        viewModel.accounts.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { accounts ->
            if (accounts.isNotEmpty()) {
                val primaryAccount = accounts.firstOrNull { it.isPrimary }
                primaryAccount?.let {
                    binding.tvAccountBalance.text = String.format("$%,.2f", it.balance)
                    binding.tvAccountNumber.text = "Account: ${it.accountNumber}"
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}
```

### TransactionAdapter.kt
```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    inner class TransactionViewHolder(val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.binding.apply {
            tvDate.text = transaction.date
            tvDescription.text = transaction.description
            tvAmount.text = "${transaction.amount}"

            // Set color based on transaction type
            if (transaction.type == "DEBIT") {
                tvAmount.setTextColor(Color.RED)
            } else {
                tvAmount.setTextColor(Color.GREEN)
            }

            tvBalanceAfter.text = "Balance: ${transaction.balanceAfter}"
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = transactions.size
}
```

## 4. Database Implementation

### AppDatabase.kt
```kotlin
@Database(
    entities = [User::class, Account::class, Transaction::class],
    version = 1,
    exportSchema = false
)
abstract class AppDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun userDao(): UserDao
    abstract fun accountDao(): AccountDao
    abstract fun transactionDao(): TransactionDao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: AppDatabase? = null

        fun getDatabase(context: Context): AppDatabase {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                val instance = Room.databaseBuilder(
                    context.applicationContext,
                    AppDatabase::class.java,
                    "banking_app_db"
                ).build()
                INSTANCE = instance
                instance
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### DAO Interfaces

```kotlin
@Dao
interface UserDao {
    @Insert
    suspend fun insert(user: User)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM user WHERE email = :email AND password = :password")
    suspend fun getUserByCredentials(email: String, password: String): User?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM user WHERE id = :userId")
    suspend fun getUserById(userId: String): User?
}

@Dao
interface AccountDao {
    @Insert
    suspend fun insert(account: Account)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM account WHERE userId = :userId")
    suspend fun getAccountsByUserId(userId: String): List<Account>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM account WHERE accountNumber = :accountNumber")
    suspend fun getAccountByNumber(accountNumber: String): Account?

    @Update
    suspend fun update(account: Account)
}

@Dao
interface TransactionDao {
    @Insert
    suspend fun insert(transaction: Transaction)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM transaction WHERE accountNumber = :accountNumber ORDER BY timestamp DESC")
    suspend fun getTransactionsByAccount(accountNumber: String): List<Transaction>
}
```

## 5. ViewModel

### BankingViewModel.kt
```kotlin
class BankingViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val database = AppDatabase.getDatabase(application)
    private val userDao = database.userDao()
    private val accountDao = database.accountDao()
    private val transactionDao = database.transactionDao()

    private val _currentUser = MutableLiveData<User?>()
    val currentUser: LiveData<User?> = _currentUser

    private val _userAccounts = MutableLiveData<List<Account>>()
    val userAccounts: LiveData<List<Account>> = _userAccounts

    private val _transactions = MutableLiveData<List<Transaction>>()
    val transactions: LiveData<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    private val _transferResult = MutableLiveData<Boolean>()
    val transferResult: LiveData<Boolean> = _transferResult

    fun login(email: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val user = userDao.getUserByCredentials(email, password)
            _currentUser.value = user
            if (user != null) {
                loadUserAccounts(user.id)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadUserAccounts(userId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _userAccounts.value = accountDao.getAccountsByUserId(userId)
        }
    }

    fun loadTransactions(accountNumber: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _transactions.value = transactionDao.getTransactionsByAccount(accountNumber)
        }
    }

    fun transferMoney(
        fromAccountNumber: String,
        toAccountNumber: String,
        amount: Double,
        description: String
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val fromAccount = accountDao.getAccountByNumber(fromAccountNumber)
                val toAccount = accountDao.getAccountByNumber(toAccountNumber)

                if (fromAccount == null || toAccount == null) {
                    _transferResult.value = false
                    return@launch
                }

                if (fromAccount.balance < amount) {
                    _transferResult.value = false
                    return@launch
                }

                // Update balances
                val newFromBalance = fromAccount.balance - amount
                val newToBalance = toAccount.balance + amount

                accountDao.update(fromAccount.copy(balance = newFromBalance))
                accountDao.update(toAccount.copy(balance = newToBalance))

                // Create transactions
                val timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis()
                val fromTransaction = Transaction(
                    id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                    accountNumber = fromAccountNumber,
                    amount = -amount,
                    type = "Transfer",
                    timestamp = timestamp,
                    description = description,
                    recipientAccount = toAccountNumber
                )

                val toTransaction = Transaction(
                    id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                    accountNumber = toAccountNumber,
                    amount = amount,
                    type = "Transfer",
                    timestamp = timestamp,
                    description = description,
                    recipientAccount = fromAccountNumber
                )

                transactionDao.insert(fromTransaction)
                transactionDao.insert(toTransaction)

                _transferResult.value = true
                loadUserAccounts(_currentUser.value?.id ?: "")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _transferResult.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    fun logout() {
        _currentUser.value = null
        _userAccounts.value = emptyList()
        _transactions.value = emptyList()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var viewModel: BankingViewModel

        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)

            if (user != null) {
                startActivity(Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java))
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

        }
```

```kotlin
class TransferFragment : Fragment() {
    private var _binding: FragmentTransferBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!
    private lateinit var viewModel: BankingViewModel

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentTransferBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        viewModel = ViewModelProvider(requireActivity()).get(BankingViewModel::class.java)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccount = binding.fromAccountEditText.text.toString()
            val toAccount = binding.toAccountEditText.text.toString()
            val amount = binding.amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()
            val description = binding.descriptionEditText.text.toString()

            if (fromAccount.isNotEmpty() && toAccount.isNotEmpty() && amount != null && amount > 0) {
                viewModel.transferMoney(fromAccount, toAccount, amount, description)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Please fill all fields correctly", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        viewModel.transferResult.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { success ->
            if (success) {
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                findNavController().popBackStack()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}
```

## 4. Repository (Mock Implementation)

```kotlin
// BankingRepository.kt
class BankingRepository {
    private val users = mutableListOf<User>()
    private val transactions = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<Transaction>>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val user1 = User("1", "John Doe", "john@example.com", "123456789", 5000.0)
        val user2 = User("2", "Jane Smith", "jane@example.com", "987654321", 3500.0)

        users.addAll(listOf(user1, user2))

        transactions[user1.id] = mutableListOf(
            Transaction("t1", "2023-05-01", 100.0, TransactionType.DEPOSIT, "Salary", 5100.0),
            Transaction("t2", "2023-05-03", 50.0, TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL, "ATM", 5050.0)
        )

        transactions[user2.id] = mutableListOf(
            Transaction("t3", "2023-05-02", 200.0, TransactionType.TRANSFER, "From John", 3700.0)
        )
    }

    fun login(email: String, password: String): User? {
        // In a real app, this would validate against a server
        return users.find { it.email == email }
    }

    fun getUserTransactions(userId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions[userId] ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun getUserBalance(userId: String): Double {
        return users.find { it.id == userId }?.balance ?: 0.0
    }

    fun makeTransfer(senderId: String, recipientAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val sender = users.find { it.id == senderId } ?: return false
        val recipient = users.find { it.accountNumber == recipientAccount } ?: return false

        if (sender.balance < amount) return false

        // Update balances
        sender.balance -= amount
        recipient.balance += amount

        // Record transactions
        val senderTransaction = Transaction(
            id = "t${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
            date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
            amount = amount,
            type = TransactionType.TRANSFER,
            description = "To ${recipient.name}",
            balanceAfter = sender.balance
        )

        val recipientTransaction = Transaction(
            id = "t${System.currentTimeMillis() + 1}",
            date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
            amount = amount,
            type = TransactionType.TRANSFER,
            description = "From ${sender.name}",
            balanceAfter = recipient.balance
        )

        transactions[sender.id]?.add(senderTransaction)
        transactions[recipient.id]?.add(recipientTransaction)

        return true
    }
}
```

## 5. ViewModel

```kotlin
// BankingViewModel.kt
class BankingViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val repository = BankingRepository()
    private val _user = MutableLiveData<User?>()
    val user: LiveData<User?> = _user

    private val _transactions = MutableLiveData<List<Transaction>>()
    val transactions: LiveData<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    private val _balance = MutableLiveData<Double>()
    val balance: LiveData<Double> = _balance

    private val _error = MutableLiveData<String?>()
    val error: LiveData<String?> = _error

    fun login(email: String, password: String) {
        val loggedInUser = repository.login(email, password)
        if (loggedInUser != null) {
            _user.value = loggedInUser
            loadUserData(loggedInUser.id)
        } else {
            _error.value = "Invalid credentials"
        }
    }

    private fun loadUserData(userId: String) {
        _transactions.value = repository.getUserTransactions(userId)
        _balance.value = repository.getUserBalance(userId)
    }

    fun makeTransfer(recipientAccount: String, amount: Double) {
        val userId = _user.value?.id ?: return

        if (amount <= 0) {
            _error.value = "Amount must be positive"
            return
        }

        if (repository.makeTransfer(userId, recipientAccount, amount)) {
            loadUserData(userId)
        } else {
            _error.value = "Transfer failed. Check recipient account and balance."
        }
    }

    fun clearError() {
        _error.value = null
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private lateinit var viewModel: BankingViewModel

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        viewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(BankingViewModel::class.java)

        binding.loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val email = binding.emailEditText.text.toString()
            val password = binding.passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (email.isNotEmpty() && password.isNotEmpty()) {
                viewModel.login(email, password)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter email and password", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        viewModel.user.observe(this) { user ->
            if (user != null) {
                startActivity(Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java))
                finish()
            }
        }

        viewModel.error.observe(this) { error ->
            error?.let {
                Toast.makeText(this, it, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                viewModel.clearError()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class DashboardFragment : Fragment() {
    private var _binding: FragmentDashboardBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!
    private lateinit var viewModel: BankingViewModel

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentDashboardBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        viewModel = ViewModelProvider(requireActivity()).get(BankingViewModel::class.java)

        viewModel.user.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { user ->
            user?.let {
                binding.userNameTextView.text = it.name
                binding.accountNumberTextView.text = "Account: ${it.accountNumber}"
            }
        }

        viewModel.balance.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { balance ->
            binding.balanceTextView.text = String.format("$%,.2f", balance)
        }

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            showTransferDialog()
        }
    }

    private fun showTransferDialog() {
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext()).inflate(R.layout.dialog_transfer, null)
        val builder = AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Make a Transfer")
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton("Transfer") { _, _ -> }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)

        val dialog = builder.create()
        dialog.show()

        dialog.getButton(DialogInterface.BUTTON_POSITIVE).setOnClickListener {
            val recipientAccount = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.recipientAccountEditText).text.toString()
            val amountText = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.amountEditText).text.toString()

            if (recipientAccount.isNotEmpty() && amountText.isNotEmpty()) {
                try {
                    val amount = amountText.toDouble()
                    viewModel.makeTransfer(recipientAccount, amount)
                    dialog.dismiss()
                } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Invalid amount", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Please fill all fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}
```

### TransactionAdapter.kt

```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter : ListAdapter<Transaction, TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>(DiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_transaction, parent, false)
        return TransactionViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(transaction)
    }

    class TransactionViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        private val dateTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.dateTextView)
        private val descriptionTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.descriptionTextView)
        private val amountTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.amountTextView)

        fun bind(transaction: Transaction) {
            dateTextView.text = transaction.date
            descriptionTextView.text = transaction.description

            val amountText = when (transaction.type) {
                TransactionType.DEPOSIT, TransactionType.TRANSFER -> "+${transaction.amount}"
                else -> "-${transaction.amount}"
            }

            amountTextView.text = amountText
            amountTextView.setTextColor(
                if (transaction.type == TransactionType.DEPOSIT || transaction.type == TransactionType.TRANSFER)
                    ContextCompat.getColor(itemView.context, R.color.green)
                else
                    ContextCompat.getColor(itemView.context, R.color.red)
            )
        }
    }

    class DiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Transaction>() {
        override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
            return oldItem.id == newItem.id
        }

        override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
            return oldItem == newItem
        }
    }
}
```
